newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers up slightly, sellers holding off.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers up slightly, sellers holding off.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted slightly higher on Thursday with suppliers not eager to sell after recent active trade, traders said.
"There is less downside than upside," said the major.
Enquiries were thin after the recent spate of trade and offers hovered just above than Wednesday's levels, with one major offering the 380-cst at $101 per tonne and 180-cst at $108, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $100-$101 per tonne and 180-cst at $105-$108. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $186-$188 and $198-$202 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
